heading_1.jcr:title: Terms & Conditions - MEP100 Ecosystem Partners Tour Challenge Raffle

image_1.alt: Terms & Conditions - MEP100 Ecosystem Partners Tour Challenge Raffle banner

text_1.text: This promotion (the “Raffle”) is organized by Macnica Americas, Inc., 380 Stevens Avenue, Suite 206, Solana Beach, California 92075, USA (“Organizer”), joined by Softron Microcomputing S.A./N.V., Avenue Molière, 470, 1050 Brussels, Belgium, and Leading Light Technologies Ltd, trading as L2Tek, 1st Floor, The Hub, Fowler Avenue, Farnborough, Hampshire, GU14 7JF, United Kingdom, as the partners/sponsors. The Raffle is conducted in accordance with the Dutch Gedragscode Promotionele Kansspelen (Code of Conduct for Promotional Games of Chance).

text_2.text:
• Participation is free of charge. No purchase is required.
  • Participants must be attendees of IBC 2025, Amsterdam, and complete the Ecosystem Partners Tour Challenge by collecting partner booth stamps on the official card.
  • A completed card and a business card must be submitted at the Macnica stand (Hall 2, Stand 2.A46) by 17:00 CET on 14 September, 2025.
  • Only one entry per participant is permitted.

text_3.text:
• Open to individuals aged 18 years or older who are attendees of IBC 2025.
  • Employees of Macnica Americas, Inc., its affiliates, ecosystem partners, and their immediate families are excluded.
  • Entries that are incomplete, late, or illegible will not be accepted.

text_4.text:
• One winner will be selected at random from eligible entries.
  • The prize is: Apple Vision Pro (approx. value €3,999).
  • Total prize value does not exceed €4,500, in compliance with Dutch regulations.
  • If the prize value exceeds €454, Dutch gaming tax (kansspelbelasting) may apply. The Organizer will bear responsibility for such tax.

text_5.text:
• The draw will take place the Macnica stand 2.A46, 17:30 CET on 14 September 2025.
  • The winner does not need to be present at the draw.
  • The winner will be notified within 7 days by email or phone using the details provided on the submitted business card.
  • If the winner does not respond within 14 days, the prize may be forfeited, and another winner may be drawn.
  • The Organizer reserves the right to verify eligibility and to refuse to award a prize if false information was provided.

text_6.text:
• Personal data collected (business card information) will be used solely for the purposes of administering the Raffle and contacting the winner.
  • Data will be retained only as long as necessary to complete the Raffle process and will be securely deleted no later than 31 October, 2025.
  • Data will not be used for marketing purposes unless participants provide explicit opt-in consent.
  • Participants have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of their personal data by contacting info.mai@macnica.com.

text_7.text:
• Any complaints regarding the Raffle may be submitted in writing to the Organizer at the above address.
  • If a complaint cannot be resolved, participants may contact the Dutch Gaming Authority (Kansspelautoriteit).

text_8.text:
• The Organizer is not responsible for technical issues, lost entries, or events outside its control.
  • No cash alternatives or substitutions are available, except at the Organizer’s discretion if the prize becomes unavailable.

text_9.text:
• These Terms are governed by Dutch law.
  • Any disputes arising out of or in connection with the Raffle shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of the Netherlands.
